mapper.select: select p.perms from permission as p join role_permission on p.id = role_permission.permission_id join person_role on role_permission.role_id = person_role.role_id where person_role.person_id = #{personId} and p.status = 0 and p.deleted = 0 UNION select p.perms from permission as p join person_temp_permission as ptp on p.id = ptp.permission_id where ptp.person_id = #{personId} and ptp.status = 0 and p.deleted = 0 and ptp.start_time <= now() and ptp.expire_time >= now()

SELECT p.id, p.perms, p.name, p.group_name AS groupName, p.status, p.remark, p.created_time AS createdTime, p.created_by AS createdBy, creator.username AS createdByName, p.updated_time AS updatedTime, p.updated_by AS updatedBy, updater.username AS updatedByName FROM permission p LEFT JOIN admin creator ON p.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN admin updater ON p.updated_by = updater.id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 0
